title: Military aircraft to fly over Lawrence campus Thursday, Friday in advance of KU-Missouri football game
summary_en: Military jets will fly over the University of Kansas campus Thursday, Sept. 10, and Friday, Sept. 11, in advance of Friday's KU football game versus the University of Missouri.
title_cn: Military aircraft to fly over Lawrence campus Thursday, Friday in advance of KU-Missouri football game

title: KU Law to host environmental law scholar James Salzman for lecture on drinking water
summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Law will host environmental law scholar James Salzman for a public lecture Sept. 14. “The Past, Present, and Future of Drinking Water” will take place from 4:30 to 6 p.m. in 106 Green Hall at the University of Kansas School of Law.
title_cn: KU Law to host environmental law scholar James Salzman for lecture on drinking water

title: Indigenous Arts Initiative will offer workshops on art, filmmaking
summary_en: The Indigenous Arts Initiative, which includes partners from the University of Kansas, will bring two distinguished Indigenous artists and educators to Lawrence this September for a series of free public workshops exploring art, culture, storytelling and filmmaking.
title_cn: Indigenous Arts Initiative will offer workshops on art, filmmaking
